title: The Qualitative Laboratory: Theory Prototyping and Hypothesis Generation with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of LLM-generated discourses using distinct class, geographic, and occupational personas (e.g., working-class factory worker, rural farmer) to determine if the model reproduces superficial class stereotypes or demonstrates sociologically plausible depth and reasoning.

Evaluating LLM responses to climate and educational policy frames through prompts engineered with specific political ideologies (e.g., conservative, moderate) to test if the model produces nuanced, counter-intuitive ideological logic rather than flat partisan stereotypes.
